children: NPK International Inc. (NYSE: NPKI) (“NPK” or the “Company”) today announced the appointment of James “JJ” Barton as Executive Vice President, Commercial Growth & Operations, effective September 22, 2026. Mr. Barton succeeds Lori Briggs, who will depart from her role as Executive Vice President, Business Operations effective September 14, 2026.

Mr. Barton brings more than two decades of leadership experience in strategic sales, account management, service operations, manufacturing and growth execution. He most recently served as President of Clear Water Services, a wholly owned subsidiary of Tidal Vision, where he led growth initiatives, operational improvements, and integration efforts that strengthened revenue, margins, and EBITDA performance. He previously held senior leadership roles with ZECO, Mayco Wellchem, and Baker Hughes, and holds an MBA in Corporate Entrepreneurship from Syracuse University and a B.A. in Communication and Marketing from Louisiana State University.

“We are pleased to welcome JJ to NPK as our Executive Vice President, Commercial Growth & Operations,” said Matthew Lanigan, President and Chief Executive Officer of NPK International. “JJ’s track record of driving operational performance, integrating businesses, building scalable processes, and leading teams through periods of growth and transformation aligns well with NPK’s strategic priorities. His experience in service operations, manufacturing, sales, and strategic execution will be valuable as we continue to strengthen our operating platform and deliver long-term value for our shareholders.

“On behalf of the Company, I also want to thank Lori Briggs for her many contributions over the past 8 years that have positioned our business well for its next phase of growth. Lori has provided outstanding leadership during her time at NPK and I wish her the very best in her future endeavors,” concluded Lanigan.

NPK International Inc. is a worksite access solutions company that manufactures, sells, and rents recyclable composite matting products, along with a full suite of services, including planning, logistics, and site restoration. The Company delivers superior quality and reliability across critical infrastructure markets, including electrical transmission and distribution, oil and gas exploration, pipeline, renewable energy, petrochemical, construction, and other industries.
